headline: EPS surges sequentially and year-over-year
summary_short: Doosan reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩19,608, up 794.9% q/q from ₩2,191 and up 345.1% y/y from ₩4,405.
summary_long: EPS of ₩19,608 surged 794.9% sequentially from ₩2,191 and 345.1% year-over-year from ₩4,405. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
